card.name: Digit after decimal in confidence intervals
card.fires_on: A single digit, mostly 0, right after the decimal point in a lower confidence-limit number such as 1.04 in a hazard ratio with 95% CI. It also fires on digits inside numeric tables.

modes.label: Lower CI limit
modes.description: The digit 0 just after "1." at the start of a 95% CI for a hazard ratio near 1.27.
modes.example: For all-cause mortality, the HR = 1.27; 95% CI (1.<<0>>4, 1.54);

modes.label: Table number digits
modes.description: A digit inside a row of numbers in a table or scale.

card.plain: It marks a digit inside a number, mostly the lower end of a confidence interval around a hazard ratio.
